Canva’s restructuring is affecting over 1,200 employees, but their severance deal is getting praise. Treating departing employees well keeps company morale higher. The catch: how widely this approach can be sustained financially remains unclear.
— via Fast Company Work Life

item.title: Change debt, not change fatigue, is driving burnout, research shows
item.description:
Research shows that unresolved past changes, or 'change debt', contribute to burnout more than constant change. Paying attention to past disruptions can help ease employee stress. The catch: it's based on a single study, specifics may vary between workplaces.
— via HR Dive

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:
Science says buying experiences over things can actually make you happier. The idea is that experiences, unlike objects, grow more valuable in your memory. This perspective mainly applies to individuals, not directly to workplace spendings.
— via Fast Company Work Life
